notes.title: Update Info (March 8, 2025)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054781/777186c0f3cac75881cbc5f80fb2b6eb0942b007.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Savage: Ultimate Boss Fight. Here are the update details.

[h2][u]Battle[/u][/h2]
[h3]New Feature: "Mob Hunt" Added[/h3]
[list]
    [*]A new battle content, [b]Mob Hunt[/b], has been added.
    [*]Mob Hunt is a high-difficulty battle mode that becomes available after clearing Normal difficulty.
    [*]Additional boss battles will be gradually introduced to Mob Hunt in future updates.
[/list]
[h3]New Boss Battle Added[/h3]
[list]
    [*]The first Mob Hunt boss battle, [b]vs. Spiritual Golem[/b], has been added.
[/list]

[h2][u]Character[/u][/h2]
[h3]New Feature: "Mastery" Implemented[/h3]
[list]
    [*]A new character enhancement system, [b]Mastery[/b], has been implemented.
    [*]Use Mastery Points to enhance your character.
    [*]Mastery Points can be obtained as rewards from Mob Hunt.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustment to Skill Effects[/h3]
[list]
    [*]The effect range of the Paladin's skills is now displayed on the field while in use.
    [*]The duration of the status effects [b]"Phantom Dart"[/b] and [b]"Fairy Veil"[/b], granted by the Archer's skills, has been changed to permanent and will no longer expire over time.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustment to Equipment Effects[/h3]
[list]
    [*]The activation condition for [b]"Mystic Ward"[/b] has been changed from "HP must be at 100%" to "HP must be at 90% or higher." Its damage reduction rate has been reduced to 10%.
    [*]The evasion rate of [b]"Cloak of Evasion"[/b] has been reduced to 15%.
    [*]The healing effect boost of the Fairy from [b]"Fairis Amber"[/b] has been reduced to 25%.
[/list]

[h2][u]Other[/u][/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where the critical damage boost effect of the equipment [b]"Talon"[/b] was not applied when the additional damage from the status effect [b]"Phantom Dart"[/b] became a critical hit.
    [*]Fixed an issue where status effects from the previous battle would sometimes persist after restarting a battle.
    [*]Fixed an issue where the sound effects for the Paladin's skills sometimes did not play correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Info
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054781/9423288e624aa919fa5d3b990db79999b415921f.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Savage: Ultimate Boss Fight. Here is the update details for the demo version.

Please note that with this update, the save data for the demo version has been reset. We apologize for any inconvenience caused to players.

[h2][u]Battle[/u][/h2]
[h3]Boss battle changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Actions of each enemy in battles have been added or modified.
[/list]
[h3]Battle system changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]The player's auto-attack now automatically targets enemies based on their remaining HP, selecting the ones with low HP first.
    [*]The area-of-effect effect has been removed from the player's auto-attack, and it now deals damage to a single target.
    [*]A new player stat, "TP" has been added. Learning specific skills will increase TP during auto-attacks. TP is consumed when using certain skills.
    [*]A new player stat, "Critical" has been added. Critical hits occur during auto-attacks based on the critical value, dealing higher damage than normal.
[/list]
[h3]New Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
    [*]The tutorial content has been updated.
    [*]A new boss battle has been added.
[/list]

[h2][u]Character Enhancement[/u][/h2]
[h3]Level up[/h3]
[list]
    [*]The character gains experience points through battles and can level up.
[/list]
[h3]Stat enhancement[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Upon leveling up, the character receives enhancement points that can be used to strengthen their stats.
[/list]
[h3]Skill acquisition[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Clearing specific boss battles for the first time grants skill points. Skill points can be used to learn new skills for the character.
[/list]
[h3]New skills[/h3]
[list]
    [*]New skills have been added for the Paladin and Archer characters.
[/list]

[h2][u]System[/u][/h2]
[h3]UI changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]The UI on the menu screen and battle screen has been updated.
[/list]
[h3]BGM changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Some battle background music has been changed.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustment of gamepad stick controls[/h3]
[list]
    [*]To address the issue of the character moving without stick input, the dead zone of the stick controls has been adjusted.
[/list]

Thank you once again for your support, and I hope you continue to enjoy the game.

Sincerely,
